Name: Obed, Son of Boaz
Summary: Obed, son of Boaz and Ruth, was born in Bethlehem and became the father of Jesse and grandfather of David, carrying the line named in Ruth's genealogy.
KeyStory: When Ruth bore a son, the women of Bethlehem named him Obed and told Naomi he would be a restorer of her life; Obed became the father of Jesse, the father of David.
RelatedPeople: Boaz; Ruth; Jesse, Son of Obed; Naomi
LifeLesson: A child born to a foreign widow became the hinge of a king's line.
